D5/S3/Quantum/Information/GroupInvariant.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.GroupInvariantPsi.C129QubitBargmann.explicit_qubit_orientation
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/GroupInvariant.signature: theorem explicit_qubit_orientation : tripleBargmann ![(0 : ℝ), 0, 1] ![1, 0, 0] ![0, 1, 0] = (1 + Complex.I) / 4 ∧ tripleBargmann ![(0 : ℝ), 0, 1] ![1, 0, 0] ![0, -1, 0] = (1 - Complex.I) / 4

D5/S3/Quantum/Information/GroupInvariant.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.GroupInvariantPsi.C129QubitBargmann.triple_bargmann_bloch
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/GroupInvariant.signature: theorem triple_bargmann_bloch (r₁ r₂ r₃ : Fin 3 → ℝ) : tripleBargmann r₁ r₂ r₃ = (((1 + r₁ ⬝ᵥ r₂ + r₂ ⬝ᵥ r₃ + r₃ ⬝ᵥ r₁ : ℝ) : ℂ) / 4) + (((r₁ ⬝ᵥ (r₂ ⨯₃ r₃) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I / 4)
